The '''Korriban regiment''', also known as '''sentries''', were a portion of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|reconstituted Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was stationed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]], [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Cormun (Imperial Army)|Cormun]] was a part of the Korriban regiment's [[Fifth Infantry company]].[[File:A_Korriban_Regiment_soldier_observes_the_Sith_Academy_grounds.png|left|thumb|A soldier of the Regiment observes the grounds of the [[Sith Academy (Korriban)|Sith Academy]] ]]

Unlike most soldiers in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]], many of the men and women of the Korriban regiment's armor was a distinct red, rather than the commonplace gray.
